title: ITSP.10.171 media storage safeguards and authorized access need assessment evidence
remediation: The sponsor media custodian inventories system media holding specified information and approves storage controls, custodians and access roles. Review physical safeguards and effective access, and sample a controlled retrieval or checkout and return. Document inherited storage boundaries and authorized evidence. The sponsor confirms the assessed ITSP.10.171 supplementary boundary and accountable owner.

milestones.title: Collect an approved media and storage inventory, physical and access safeguards, and redacted custody and retrieval evidence
